<pre>'''Note:''' This hub is the '''Virtual Legacy''' (2009&ndash;2014 Block packaging) entry for Defensive Shields. For the Original-era printable slips see [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]] (alias redirect: [[Virtual Shields (Original)]]). Alias: [[Virtual Shields (Legacy)]].

'''Virtual Shields''' (Legacy Defensive Shields) is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The hub Date keeps the '''earlier''' first-appearance window '''~2006-07''' (Defensive Shields / Virtual Shields packaging placed between Virtual Sets 11 and 12 on contemporaneous secondary lists; Original-era printable slips are documented on [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]] (Resources DefensiveShields.pdf, Dec 2006)).<ref name="premiumshields">https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html</ref> Primary PDF brackets: after VS11 official text '''4 December 2006''' and before VS12 official text '''9 January 2007''' (exact Original shields PDF / news day still unknown; Alpha1 '''NOT FOUND'''). The shields were later grouped/labeled as Virtual Block Defensive Shields in the September/October 2009 Block packaging era (cardlist snapshot 2 October 2009).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.</pre>

== Leave Them To Me (V) in pre-2009 decklists: settled (2026-10-16) ==
Six decklists from 2008–2009 linked Leave Them To Me (V). Checked against the scanned sheets:
* The five 2008 Worlds lists did not have it. Walseth's Light Side line 28 is Krayt Dragon Howl (V) ([[2008 Worlds Day 1 Walseth LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]). The four Day 2 Endor Operations pages were one copied list. Each is now transcribed from its own sheet: [[2008 Worlds Day 2 Jesse Reynolds DS Endor Operations]], [[2008 Worlds Day 2 Jan Westergard DS Endor Operations]], [[2008 Worlds Day 2 Michael Raveling DS Endor Operations]], and [[2008 Worlds Day 2 Tom Frafjord DS Endor Operations]]. The page-106 sheet is Tom Frafjord's, not Ian Westergaard's.
* [[2009 Worlds Day 3 Brian Hunter DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]] really lists it: shield 11 with the V box ticked. At Worlds 2009 (October) the only (V) printing was the Reflections IV slip on Virtual Block 6.1 (official text 4 September 2009), [[Leave Them To Me (Death Star II) (V)]]. That deck and the 2009 Worlds lists that wrote Leave Them To Me (V) but linked the Decipher card now link that page.
* Open: the page [[Leave Them To Me (V)]] uses the PC card-list image "Leave Them To Me (Ref III)". That image has no (V) and a 2001 copyright. It may be the Decipher Reflections III card, not a second virtual printing. The other eight Reflections III pairs on the PC list (e.g. Your Insight Serves You Well, No Escape) do show (V). 2010–2014 decklists with Leave Them To Me (V) were not changed. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 19:49, 16 October 2026 (UTC)

== Build notes (2026-10-16) ==
Decklists from events before the Virtual Block sheets (Worlds 2009, 8–11 October 2009, and earlier) now link the Original Virtual printing of Traffic Control, Reactor Terminal, Abyss, Chasm, Affect Mind, The Professor, I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing, Death Star Sentry, After Her!, Yavin Sentry (Virtual Sets 2, 3, 9, 13, 14) and Do They Have A Code Clearance? ([[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]]) instead of the Virtual Shields pages (308 decklists). Later decks list Battle Plan (V), Secret Plans (V) and the other 2006-sheet shields, whose only (V) printing is the 2006 sheet; the 2013 master list prints those titles without (V) in Decipher's wording. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 19:26, 16 October 2026 (UTC)

== Leave Them To Me (V): two printings (2026-10-17) ==
The open point above is settled. The 6.1 sheet (page 4) has two Leave Them To Me (V) slips: number 22, Leave Them To Me (Reflections III) (V), and number 23, Leave Them To Me (Death Star II) (V). The game text is the same. [[Leave Them To Me (V)]] is the Reflections III version; its card-list image still shows the old card art. The same pairs exist for No Escape, Do They Have A Code Clearance?, You Cannot Hide Forever, Ounee Ta, Your Insight Serves You Well and Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here. Decklists from Worlds 2009 tick only "V", so they cannot say which of the two slips was played; they link the Death Star II version. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 11:47, 17 October 2026 (UTC)
